system.longDesc: You are experienced with bows and crossbows.

degree0.desc: When you take the Aim action, your next attack with a bow or crossbow inflicts +1 damage in addition to the normal benefits of aiming.

degree1.desc: When you attack from hiding with a bow or crossbow and fail, you remain hidden. If the attack is successful, you can immediately make a new Dexterity (Stealth) test if there is cover within 4 yards and you have not moved yet in your turn. You can enjoy each benefit only once in the same combat.

degree2.desc: When shooting a bow or crossbow, you can perform the Called Shot, Hamstring, and Maim stunts for 1 SP less than their normal cost.
